supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:39 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, followed by a privileged-logon event for the same account and logon ID.
At 13:44:39 UTC, PowerShell ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01 as omar.haddad with the command line invoking the organization's specified patch script, \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1.

The observed PowerShell execution is consistent with the documented IT practice and scheduled workstation patching; the available evidence supports it as the likely explanation for the reported window.
The PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 update, and the proxy recorded a Windows Update download during the same period.
The PowerShell process terminated at 13:45:06 UTC, shortly after the update installer process terminated.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the PowerShell command line and its child process, but do not provide the contents, hash, signature, or execution output of Deploy-Patches.ps1.
The logs do not establish whether the patch installation completed successfully.
The evidence records process execution, not whether or how long a PowerShell window was visible to maria.lopez.
claims_not_established: The logs do not establish the integrity or full behavior of the patch script itself.
The logs do not establish that maria.lopez's reported window appeared at precisely 13:40 UTC; the recorded PowerShell start is 13:44:39 UTC.
unrelated_findings: A taskhostw.exe process on WS-MLOPEZ-01 attempted explicit authentication to PROXY-HD-01 using svc-bkp; inventory describes svc-bkp as a backup agent account on FILE-HD-01. Review separately; this does not decide the alerted PowerShell activity. (T024-00043, T024-00045)

Google Drive File Stream launched under maria.lopez, although the inventory lists Microsoft 365/OneDrive as approved and no other cloud-storage services as approved. The records establish execution, not data upload; review separately. (T024-00278, T024-00280, T024-00281)

Palo Alto GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-MLOPEZ-01, while the inventory states there is no VPN. The records do not establish a VPN connection; review separately. (T024-00039, T024-00040)
